visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a view from a high-floor window through translucent white curtains, looking down at a dimly lit urban street at night. Several scooters are parked along the sidewalk. Text overlays in white and red appear, introducing the topic of garbage truck music. The camera shakes slightly, suggesting a handheld phone recording. (2) The scene cuts to a ground-level view of a vibrant yellow garbage truck parked on a busy street at night. Several individuals in dark clothing are seen tossing white trash bags into the mechanical compactor at the rear of the truck. Street lights and building signs provide warm artificial illumination in the background. (3) A young woman with her hair tied back in a ponytail is shown sitting at a polished brown grand piano in a brightly lit room with white tiled walls. She wears a beige sleeveless top and a white, ruffled tiered skirt. She points her finger and speaks enthusiastically before playing specific notes and chords on the piano keys. (4) The visual transitions into a layered composition where the piano performance is superimposed with the previously seen footage of the yellow garbage truck. A large yellow and white text box mentions a 3 million dollar piano. The woman continues to play the waltz-style accompaniment with focused expressions. (5) The woman remains seated at the piano, leaning slightly toward the camera as she speaks directly to the viewers. Her facial expressions are animated and friendly. Text prompts appear at the bottom asking for comments and preferences between the off-key version and the elegant version of the music.
